title: Doggy Time
description: Sneak near your sitting tamed dogs to cuddle and regenerate health! Experience heartwarming moments with your loyal companions while receiving healing benefits. Perfect for strengthening the bond with your pets.
body:
🐶 Cuddle Up with Your Loyal Dogs! ❤️✨

Sneak up to your sitting tamed dogs to enjoy:

💖 Heartwarming cuddles

✨ Health regeneration as you bond

🐾 Stronger connections with your furry companions

Nothing beats the magic of healing through love and loyalty! 🐕💛

For support or inquiries, message me on discord:
procurer
